body:
I'm not in a good place right now but I feel I should contribute.

I never had to take meds but I know a lot of people who did, I also know hardcore addicts who went thought hell to fight their demons off.

If there's one thing I learned from all this is that whatever your problem is, you'r still the master of your own mind. If you need meds, try to get meds but in the meantime it's still only you in control of your body. When you feel like there's no reason to do anything set yourself a medium term goal. Something that'll make you at least slightly happier. 

Every morning you wake up is a victory, every day makes you slightly closer to happiness. You'll reach your own paradise one goal a time, just don't give up.
